name: voxbridge
description: Generate multi-provider speech and dialogue, music, and sound effects for playback, file download, or both through one ChatGPT workflow.

interface.longDescription: Generate realistic speech and ordered multi-voice dialogue across supported providers, original music through ElevenLabs, Google Lyria 2 or Lyria 3 Preview, or Stability Stable Audio 3, and sound effects through ElevenLabs SFX v3 or Stability. Play compatible results immediately, explicitly download the exact audio file, or do both while VoxBridge handles each provider's supported controls.
defaultPrompt: Read this aloud through VoxBridge without creating a download.
Generate this script as a downloadable audio file without playing it.
Read this aloud and also give me the audio file.
